name: Letter to Stormpike
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details: I have a colleague in Ironforge who may be able to help decrypt this letter.  Go to the Library in the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge and speak with Prospector Stormpike.  Tell him I sent you and show him the letter.  If there's anyone north of Blackrock Spire who can read this, it is he.
narrative.objectives: Take the Cleverly Encrypted Letter to Prospector Stormpike in Ironforge.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, encryption! A specialty of mine. Let me see here...
narrative.requestItemsText: Dibbs from Southshore sent you, did he? How is the old bookworm doing?

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 34 to 40, 7,200 XP in all.
